targetTest: marks the held and failed rows of open decisions and ready runs delivered, counts each decision once, and leaves the rest alone
expected: A successful digest counts the open decisions once and the review-ready runs, marks the held and failed decision, review and earlier digest rows it covered as delivered, leaves a row about a decision that is no longer open and a blocked-run row alone, holds its own row in quiet hours (one held digest row, reused), and ends failed after three attempts when osascript fails while the covered rows keep their state; the ledger lets a failed row move to delivered through setNotificationState only
actual: runDigest created a new pending digest row on every run, never looked at the held and failed rows (so none was marked delivered), ignored quiet hours and posted a banner inside them, and setNotificationState refused failed -> delivered, so the coverage, quiet-hours, repeated-digest and ledger-edge tests fail on assertions
semanticAssessment: The failures are assertion failures on row states, call counts and the body text (a row still held where delivered is expected, an osascript call inside quiet hours, an 'invalid' refusal missing for the failed -> delivered move), never load, import or syntax errors: runDigest exists from Task 1 and the Task 1 tests of the same file still pass, and the gated real launchd test is skipped here by design.
